verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox docs say it can run development servers and test applications with "live previews", which implies services inside the sandbox can be reached. The pack never documents exposing a specific port or a public preview URL, so only the general preview capability is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit port-exposure configuration, documentation of public preview URL generation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a port from the sandbox on a public preview URL to reach services running inside

citations.quote: Run development servers: Spin up and test applications with live previews.
Preview how user-submitted or agent-generated code behaves in a self-contained environment with access to logs, file edits, and live previews.
